items.title: Leonard Bocage Interview, 1972-03-24
items.q: You take little George Lewis, great clown that player, but he played by head.

ctx.x: In fact, I never did read no music playing this. Playing the guitar, playing by head. Mm-hmm. In fact, most of those fellas in them days, most all of them, played by head. You take little George Lewis, great clown that player, but he played by head.
